detects.small_cut: Marked feature below the minimum markable size

detects.cut_near_bend: Internal cut too close to a bend
detects.curl_near_bend: Curl too close to a bend
detects.hem_near_bend: Hem too close to a bend
detects.different_bend_directions: Bends formed in different directions in the same plane
detects.split_bends: One bend formable as split sections
detects.close_bends: Parallel bends too close (U or Z)
detects.w_bending_may_be_required: Deep U where shortest-leg / bend-separation exceeds the threshold
detects.additional_operations_required: Faces not hittable with standard/secondary tooling
detects.exceeds_press_length: Bend length exceeds the press working length
detects.dimensions_exceed_limits: Folded or unfolded part too large
detects.deep_hole: Cut-depth to hole-diameter ratio too high
detects.deep_cut_radiused: Concave profiled face too deep for the tool diameter
detects.deep_circular_pocket: Circular pocket too deep for the tool diameter
detects.deep_cut_planar: Planar profiled face too deep for the tool diameter
detects.tipped_hole: Blind hole with a drill-tip bottom (harder chip clearing)
detects.flat_bottom_hole: Blind hole with a flat bottom (harder chip clearing)
detects.slanted_hole: Hole entry/exit normal deviates from the axis
detects.hole_through_cavity: Coaxial holes split by a cavity
detects.transitions: Concave fillet, convex fillet, chamfer transitions
detects.milling_tight_corners: Internal 90-degree corners / square pockets (no round tool)
detects.bored_hole_without_relief: Bore relief-distance to diameter ratio too low
detects.slender_part: Total-length to smallest-diameter ratio too high
detects.steep_profile: External face angle to the axis too steep
detects.off_axis_hole: Hole not machinable axially or perpendicular (live tooling)
detects.asymmetric_cavity: Cavity not symmetric about the axis (live tooling)
detects.angled_cut: Non-perpendicular cut to the tube axis (extra axis needed)
